question: The served floor guarantees sens>=0.90 on ANY ROP, stage 1 included. Would a floor on severe ROP (stage>=3 proxy) buy meaningful specificity, and what mild-ROP sensitivity would it cost?
severe_proxy: label >= 3 (stage_3, stage_4_5, arop). A PROXY ONLY: no zone or plus-disease labels exist in this data, and real treatment criteria (ETROP Type 1) require both.

counterfactual_severe_floor.selection_rule: identical rule, floor applied to stage>=3 only

caveats: external dev half was used to select BOTH thresholds -> its numbers are in-sample
class counts at the external site are small for stage_4_5 (14) and arop (6)
nothing in the served app changes unless the endpoint decision is made explicitly
